Contract EnterValidatedCreditReferencesModule::markRequestValid(): Boolean {
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequests->includes(CurrentLoanRequest) and
		CurrentLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::SUBMITTED
	postcondition:
		let currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest in
		currentLoanRequest.oclIsNew() and
		currentLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::REFERENCESVALIDATED and
		result = true
}
